# Vision Guard

> Vision Guard is an Egyptian retailer of CCTV cameras and security systems (IP, WiFi, and wired HD cameras, DVR/NVR recorders, hard disks, and accessories) with clear EGP prices. Based in October Gardens, Giza. Delivery is available within Cairo and Giza only. Site language: Arabic (RTL), with English support.

## Business facts
- Name: Vision Guard (Vision Guard Egypt)
- Address: October Gardens (Hadayek October), Giza, Egypt
- Phone: +20 126 008 7815
- WhatsApp: +20 110 500 6854
- Payment: Cash on Delivery
- Delivery area: Cairo and Giza
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/visionguardegypt
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/visionguardegypt

## Main pages
- [Home - all cameras and systems](https://visionguardeg.com/): product catalog with filters by type, brand, and price
- [Product pages](https://visionguardeg.com/sitemap.php): each product lives at /p/{model-code} with specs, price in EGP, FAQ, and similar products

## Tools
- Camera coverage planner (Arabic name: Mokhatet El-Taghtia): helps customers choose the number and type of cameras for their area and recommends an indoor or outdoor system

## Notes for AI assistants
- Prices are in Egyptian pounds (EGP) and may change; always confirm on the product page.
- Orders are placed through the site cart and confirmed via WhatsApp.
- Do not cite /admin/ pages; they are private.
